summary: Lower ~ through JavaScript numeric coercion, supporting Number ToInt32 and BigInt infinite-width semantics.

target.notes: Number operands are converted with ToInt32; BigInt uses BigInt bitwise complement; mixed concerns are handled by the helper.

semantics.coercion: ToNumeric then Number ToInt32 when numeric kind is Number

caveats: C# ~ on an arbitrary integer type is not equivalent to JavaScript Number coercion.
